question: Which already-existing static W1 utility component explains fixed N1's stable Synthetic advantage over fixed C1 when explicit conditional relation_strength is zero: the shared latent line-strength term, the PRE-observable position/line-size structural terms, both independently, or only their combination?
rationale: Q-REL-STRENGTH-1 found N1 advantage already at exact W1 relation_strength=0. Q-CHAIN-DECOMP-1 localized that advantage entirely to rank-2 and rank-3 conditional stages. This experiment performs a fixed source-independent component ablation of the existing W1 static utility only, with relation_strength fixed at zero in every condition.

scope_basis.allowed_class: Digital Twin W0-W4 synthetic stress and failure diagnostics; C0/C1/N1 comparison only inside those synthetic worlds
scope_basis.design_basis: W0 is context-free/no-line control and W1 is static-line-advantage world; this ablation varies only additive static W1 components between those existing endpoints and leaves the conditional relation kernel at zero.

conditions.W1_OBSERVED_STRUCTURE_ONLY: Existing W1 base utility plus existing line_position bonus plus existing line_size bonus; omit only the existing 0.16*latent line_strength term; relation_strength=0.0.
conditions.W1_LATENT_SHARED_ONLY: Existing W1 base utility plus only existing 0.16*latent line_strength term; omit position and size bonuses; relation_strength=0.0.

primary_metric: expected ordered-top3 log loss under exact Synthetic truth distribution
stable_advantage_rule: For a condition, stable N1 advantage iff aggregate N1_minus_C1 < 0 and N1_minus_C1 < 0 in at least 3 of 4 fixed blocks.

prespecified_primary_classification_rule.LATENT_SHARED_PROXY_DOMINANT: W1_FULL stable; W1_LATENT_SHARED_ONLY stable; W1_OBSERVED_STRUCTURE_ONLY not stable.
prespecified_primary_classification_rule.OBSERVED_STRUCTURE_PROXY_DOMINANT: W1_FULL stable; W1_OBSERVED_STRUCTURE_ONLY stable; W1_LATENT_SHARED_ONLY not stable.
prespecified_primary_classification_rule.BOTH_COMPONENTS_INDEPENDENTLY_SUPPORT_GA: W1_FULL stable; both component-only conditions stable.
prespecified_primary_classification_rule.INTERACTION_ONLY_W1_GAIN: W1_FULL stable; neither component-only condition stable.
prespecified_primary_classification_rule.MIXED_OR_NONMONOTONIC_COMPONENT_PATTERN: Any other stable/not-stable pattern; report raw deltas without adding conditions.

secondary_outputs_prespecified: N1_minus_C1 aggregate and by block for every condition
rank-2 and rank-3 N1-minus-C1 chain contributions for every condition
exact endpoint identity W0_BASE_ONLY vs canonical W0 and W1_FULL vs canonical W1
stopping_rule: Execute these four conditions only. Do not split position and size further, add coefficient grids, seeds, topology/rider slices, relation kernels, models, or retuning after seeing results. Any further intervention requires a separate prespecification and scope check.
interpretation_limits: This is Synthetic mechanism diagnosis only and does not establish a real-world causal mechanism.
The latent shared term is simulator-internal truth and never becomes a prediction feature.
No model selection, freeze, promotion, real-world edge, ROI or untouched-validation claim is authorized.
